528-joe-the-hotel-boy-or-winning-out-by-.title: Joe The Hotel Boy Or Winning Out By Pluck
528-joe-the-hotel-boy-or-winning-out-by-.creator: Horatio Alger, Jr.
528-joe-the-hotel-boy-or-winning-out-by-.description: A book by Horatio Alger, Jr.. If there is a moral to be drawn from this story, it is a twofold one, namely, that honesty is always the best policy, and that if one wishes to succeed in life he must stick at his work steadily and watch every opportunity for advancement.

arxiv-2108-06421.title: GeoCLR: Georeference Contrastive Learning for Efficient Seafloor Image Interpretation
arxiv-2108-06421.creator: Takaki Yamada, Adam Prügel-Bennett, Stefan B. Williams, Oscar Pizarro, Blair Thornton
arxiv-2108-06421.description: Abstract This paper describes Georeference Contrastive Learning of visual Representation (GeoCLR) for efficient training of deep-learning Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs). The method leverages georeference information by generating a similar image pair using images taken of nearby locations, and contrasting these with an image pair that is far apart.

arxiv-2112-06891.title: Interpretable Design of Reservoir Computing Networks using Realization Theory
arxiv-2112-06891.creator: Wei Miao, Vignesh Narayanan, and Jr-Shin Li
arxiv-2112-06891.description: Abstract The reservoir computing networks (RCNs) have been successfully employed as a tool in learning and complex decision-making tasks. Despite their efficiency and low training cost, practical applications of RCNs rely heavily on empirical design. In this paper, we develop an algorithm to design RCNs using the realization theory of linear dynamical systems.

arxiv-2112-11712.title: The bifurcation lemma for strong properties in the inverse eigenvalue problem of a graph
arxiv-2112-11712.creator: Shaun M. Fallat, H. Tracy Hall, Jephian C.-H. Lin, Bryan L. Shader
arxiv-2112-11712.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Shaun M. Fallat, H. Tracy Hall, Jephian C.-H. Lin, Bryan L. Shader. The inverse eigenvalue problem of a graph studies the real symmetric matrices whose off-diagonal pattern is prescribed by the adjacencies of the graph. The strong spectral property (SSP) is an important tool for this problem.

arxiv-2207-02137.title: Efficiently combining α \alpha CenA multi-epoch high-contrast imaging data Application of K-Stacker to the 80 hrs NEAR campaign
arxiv-2207-02137.creator: H. Le Coroller, M. Nowak, K. Wagner, M. Kasper, G. Chauvin, C. Desgrange, S. Conseil
arxiv-2207-02137.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by H. Le Coroller, M. Nowak, K. Wagner, M. Kasper, G. Chauvin, C. Desgrange, S. Conseil. Keplerian-Stacker is an algorithm able to combine multiple observations acquired at different epochs taking into account the orbital motion of a potential planet present in the images to boost the ultimate detection limit.

arxiv-2310-10830.title: Fake News in Sheep’s Clothing: Robust Fake News Detection Against LLM-Empowered Style Attacks Conference: Proceedings of the 30th ACM SIGKDD Conference on Knowledge Discovery and Data Mining; August 25–29, 2024; Barcelona, Spain Proceedings of the 30th ACM SIGKDD Conference on Knowledge Discovery an
arxiv-2310-10830.creator: Jiaying Wu, Jiafeng Guo, Bryan Hooi
arxiv-2310-10830.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Jiaying Wu, Jiafeng Guo, Bryan Hooi. It is commonly perceived that fake news and real news exhibit distinct writing styles, such as the use of sensationalist versus objective language. However, we emphasize that style-related features can also be exploited for style-based attacks . Notably, the advent of powerful Large Language Models (LLMs) has empowered malicious actors to mimic the style of trustworthy news sources, doing so swiftly, cost-effectively, and at scale.

arxiv-2412-11821.title: Fast single-qubit gates for continuous dynamically decoupled systems
arxiv-2412-11821.creator: Michael Senatore, Daniel L. Campbell, James A. Williams, Matthew D. LaHaye
arxiv-2412-11821.description: Abstract Environmental noise that couples longitudinally to a quantum system dephases that system and can limit its coherence lifetime. Performance using quantum superposition in clocks, information processors, communication networks, and sensors depends on careful state and external field selection to lower sensitivity to longitudinal noise.

arxiv-2510-08712.title: Theoretical Analysis of Topotomography Using Small Intragranular Strain Approximations
arxiv-2510-08712.creator: Zheheng Liu \IUCrCemaillink zheheng.liu@esrf.fr, Nicola Vigano \IUCrCemaillink nicola.vigano@cea.fr, Henry Proudhon, Wolfgang Ludwig \IUCrCemaillink wolfgang.ludwig@esrf.fr
arxiv-2510-08712.description: Abstract Topo-Tomography (TT) is a synchrotron-based X-ray diffraction imaging technique used to characterize grain shape and crystal orientation in polycrystalline samples. This work aims to provide a decisive and fundamental understanding of 3D grain shape and orientation field reconstruction from TT diffraction data.

pmc-10541695.title: COVID-19 vaccination-related headache showed two different clusters in the long-term course: a prospective multicenter follow-up study (COVA-Head Study)
pmc-10541695.creator: Arife Çimen Atalar, Ayşe Nur Özdağ Acarlı, Betül Baykan, Paolo Martelletti, Hayrunnisa Bolay, Mustafa Ertaş, Esme Ekizoğlu, Ömer Karadaş, Burcu Polat, Işıl Yazıcı Gençdal, David Garcia Azorin, Dimos Mitsikostas, Loukia Apostolakopoulou, Hamit Genç, Pınar Yalınay Dikmen, Esra Acıman Demirel, Elif Ilg
pmc-10541695.description: BackgroundAlthough acute headache following COVID-19 vaccination is widely acknowledged, the long-term progression of these headaches remains poorly understood. Our objective was to identify various phenotypes of prolonged or worsened headaches associated with COVID-19 vaccination and document any changes in these phenotypes over an extended period. Additionally, we aimed to document the diverse headache presentations among patients with pre-existing primary headaches.

pmc-10617921.title: Odds of HIV among incarcerated drug users: a systematic review and meta-analysis of Asian countries
pmc-10617921.creator: Hassan ul Hussain, Kanwal Ashok Kumar, Syeda Tayyaba Rehan, Zayeema Khan, Mahnoor Rehan Hashmi, Yumna Khabir, Chaudhary Abdul Fatir, Muhammad Junaid Tahir, Ali Ahmed, Oadi N. Shrateh, Md. Nazmul Huda
pmc-10617921.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Background:HIV makes up a large portion of infectious diseases globally. People injecting drugs in prisons are at high risk for contracting HIV infection. Prisons house ~10.2 million people globally, making them a high-risk setting for HIV transmission.

pmc-11334450.title: Acupuncture-related interventions improve chemotherapy-induced peripheral neuropathy: A systematic review and network meta-analysis
pmc-11334450.creator: Mei-Ling Yeh, Ru-Wen Liao, Pin-Hsuan Yeh, Chuan-Ju Lin, Yu-Jen Wang
pmc-11334450.description: BackgroundThe previous effects of acupuncture-related interventions in improving chemotherapy-induced peripheral neuropathy (CIPN) symptoms and quality of life (QoL) remain unclear in terms of pairwise comparisons.AimsThis systematic review and network meta-analysis aimed to determine the hierarchical effects of acupuncture-related interventions on symptoms, pain, and QoL associated with CIPN in cancer patients undergoing chemotherapy.

pmc-11626366.title: A comprehensive investigation of biochemical status in patients with telogen effluvium: Analysis of Hb, ferritin, vitamin B12, vitamin D, thyroid function tests, zinc, copper, biotin, and selenium levels
pmc-11626366.creator: Irem Nur Durusu Turkoglu, Aziz Kaan Turkoglu, Seçil Soylu, Gülcan Gencer, Rümeysa Duman
pmc-11626366.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). AimThe etiology of telogen effluvium (TE) includes situations that may cause physiological stress, surgical trauma, inflammatory, infectious, iatrogenic causes, medications and nutritional deficiencies. TE has been associated with iron deficiency, vitamin B12 deficiency and thyroid diseases. In recent years, the use of over‐the‐counter food supplements containing vitamins and minerals such as biotin, vitamin D, zinc (Zn), copper (Cu) and selenium (Se) has been increasing in TE patients.

pmc-12508184.title: Machine learning framework for predicting susceptibility to obesity
pmc-12508184.creator: Warda M Shaban, Hossam El-Din Moustafa, Mervat M El-Seddek
pmc-12508184.description: Obesity, currently the fifth leading cause of death worldwide, has seen a significant increase in prevalence over the past four decades. Timely identification of obesity risk facilitates proactive measures against associated factors. In this paper, we proposed a new machine learning framework for predicting susceptibility to obesity called ObeRisk.

pmc-12551076.title: Kinetics of Serum Myoglobin and Creatine Kinase Related to Exercise-Induced Muscle Damage and ACTN3 Polymorphism in Military Paratroopers Under Intense Exercise
pmc-12551076.creator: Rachel de S. Augusto, Adrieli Dill, Eliezer Souza, Tatiana L. S. Nogueira, Diego V. Gomes, Jorge Paiva, Marcos Dornelas-Ribeiro, Caleb G. M. Santos
pmc-12551076.description: Background: Physical conditioning is essential to meet the operational demands of military environments. However, high-intensity exercise provokes muscle microinjuries resulting in exercise-induced muscle damage. This condition is typically monitored using serum biomarkers such as creatine kinase (CK), myoglobin (MYO), and lactate dehydrogenase (LDH). Nevertheless, individual variability and genetic factors complicate the interpretation.

pmc-13192199.title: Primary gastric mixed germ cell tumor in an infant: the pivotal role of dynamic alpha-fetoprotein surveillance in unmasking occult malignancy
pmc-13192199.creator: Qiyang Shen, Shiyuan Wang, Chenyang Wang, Xingyu Liu, Haiyan Wu, Chunlei Zhou, Tao Li, Jianfeng Zhou, Hanjun Yin
pmc-13192199.description: This paper reports a case of an extremely rare primary mixed germ cell tumor (MGCT) of the stomach in an infant. The patient, an 8-month-old male infant, presented with “black stool for three days.” Abdominal computed tomography (CT) suggested an abdominal space-occupying lesion, and gastroscopy revealed a huge cauliflower-like protrusion on the lesser curvature of the gastric body.

pmc-13204319.title: Safety of Telemedicine Versus In-Person Care for Patients With Tracheal Devices: Propensity Score–Matched Cohort Study
pmc-13204319.creator: Pedro Prosperi Desenzi Ciaralo, Paulo Francisco Guerreiro Cardoso, Helio Minamoto, Benoit Jacques Bibas, Carlos Roberto Ribeiro Carvalho, Paulo Manuel Pego-Fernandes, Amaryllis Mavragani
pmc-13204319.description: BackgroundPatients with tracheal diseases often require long-term follow-up after tracheal device placement, with a risk of adverse events that may lead to emergency care and unplanned interventions. Telemedicine has been proposed as an alternative to in-person follow-up to improve access and continuity of care.
